satellite_features: Geostrophic Surface Current Vectors (UGOS, VGOS, UGOSA, VGOSA)
Sea Surface Salinity (SSS - SMAP / SMOS via CMEMS)
10m Surface Wind Vectors (U10, V10, Wind Speed - ERA5)
Sea Surface Temperature (SST - NOAA OISST AVHRR v2.1)
ground_truth: GLORYS12v1 Reanalysis & INCOIS Argo Float Network (CTD 0-1000m)
model_architecture: Attention U-Net / 4-Scale ResNet Deep Learning Framework
